summary: Full e2e testing for Nello Ocean Beach. Backend pytest suite: 6/6 passing (health, root, valid booking create+persist, invalid service rejection, guests<1 rejection, guests>50 rejection). Frontend Playwright: home hero (IT/EN), language toggle round-trip, all 6 navbar links, pricing placeholder '€ —', contact Maps iframe + address, sticky WhatsApp CTA, footer 'Via Mar Ionio, 22', booking form empty-validation toast, valid form submit (persists to backend + opens WhatsApp popup with prefilled message), and mobile menu all PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: WHATSAPP_NUMBER is a placeholder '393331234567' in /app/frontend/src/lib/constants.js — main agent should remind the user to set the real WhatsApp Business number before production.
Booking endpoint POST /api/bookings returns 200 instead of conventional 201 Created — functionally fine, but 201 would be more REST-correct.
server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); consider migrating to lifespan context manager.
wa.me URL gets redirected by WhatsApp to api.whatsapp.com/send (this is expected WhatsApp behavior, not a bug).
seed_data_creation: Created 2 TEST_-prefixed booking docs in MongoDB via API during tests (TEST_Mario Rossi and TEST_E2E). Safe to leave or purge.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Navbar data-testids use English keys: nav-home, nav-about, nav-services, nav-pricing, nav-booking, nav-contact (NOT IT keys like nav-chi-siamo). Routes are /about /services /pricing /booking /contact. Booking submit triggers window.open which Playwright captures via expect_popup; the URL is redirected by WhatsApp from wa.me to api.whatsapp.com — verify by checking phone=393331234567 query param instead of the wa.me hostname.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. All requested features work as specified.
